verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only batch-style generation, not general bulk operations. One POST /generations call produces 100 to 10,000 training examples, and setting max_depth trains and scores every smaller model size in one job. A community test also showed one natural-language request yielding several tool calls at once. Missing for 10: bulk actions over existing items (e.g., batch delete/update/download of models or datasets), a documented batch inference API, CLI bulk commands, and independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
